charts.title: WASP-33 b: orbits around WASP-33
charts.description: The orbits of WASP-33's planets in this map from above, to scale, with WASP-33 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Zhang et al. 2018 (2018AJ....155...83Z), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname ZHANG_ET_AL__2018): P 1.21987089 d

charts.title: WASP-33 b: its transit
charts.description: WASP-33 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (18, 58, 85) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 129979528, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 11-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 11-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
